hints: Factorise: $(5x + 2)(x - 4) = 0 \implies x = 4$ or $x = -0.4$. Find corresponding $y$-values: $P(4, 7)$ and $Q(-0.4, -1.8)$.
walkthrough:
The endpoints share both equations; their separation gives the chord length.
Substitute $y = 2x - 1$ into $(x - 1)^2 + (y - 3)^2 = 25$:
$$(x - 1)^2 + (2x - 1 - 3)^2 = 25$$
$$(x - 1)^2 + (2x - 4)^2 = 25$$
$$x^2 - 2x + 1 + 4x^2 - 16x + 16 - 25 = 0$$
$$5x^2 - 18x - 8 = 0$$

Factorise and find the coordinates of $P$ and $Q$:
$$(5x + 2)(x - 4) = 0$$
$$x = 4 \implies y = 2(4) - 1 = 7 \implies P(4, 7)$$
$$x = -\dfrac{2}{5} \implies y = 2\left(-\dfrac{2}{5}\right) - 1 = -\dfrac{9}{5} \implies Q\left(-\dfrac{2}{5}, -\dfrac{9}{5}\right)$$

The endpoints share both equations; their separation gives the chord length.
Calculate the differences in coordinates between $P(4, 7)$ and $Q\left(-\dfrac{2}{5}, -\dfrac{9}{5}\right)$:
$$\Delta x = 4 - \left(-\dfrac{2}{5}\right) = \dfrac{22}{5}$$
$$\Delta y = 7 - \left(-\dfrac{9}{5}\right) = \dfrac{44}{5}$$
